#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IN="{{src_dir}}"; OUT="{{out_dir}}"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
for f in "$IN"/*.{mp4,mov,mkv,webm}; do
  [[ -e "$f" ]] || continue
  name=$(basename "${f%.*}")
  ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss {{ts}} -i "$f" -vframes 1 -q:v 3 "$OUT/$name.jpg"
  echo "$name.jpg"
done
